name: Sanctum
description:
Casting Time: 8 hours

You transform a place where you have completed a long rest into your Sanctum. If the location is owned or inhabited, you must have the owner’s permission. You define the Sanctum’s boundaries, which must be small enough that you could walk its perimeter within one hour.

After the Sanctum has existed for at least 7 days, your presence wards it against magical and spiritual intrusion. Sound cannot cross its boundary, and the barrier appears dark, fog-shrouded, or otherwise obscured, preventing sight through it. Magical sensors cannot appear within the Sanctum or pass through its perimeter, creatures inside cannot be targeted by effects that read or influence their minds or senses, and nothing may teleport into or out of the area.

You may only maintain one Sanctum at a time. Creating a new one causes the old Sanctum to go dormant. Restoring a dormant Sanctum requires another 8 hours of work and 7 days to regain its full protections.

improvements.name: Hidden Room
improvements.description:
Your Sanctum contains a hidden demiplane, accessible only at your will. The demiplane’s maximum size in any dimension is a number of feet equal to your combined BODY, HEART, and WITS scores. You determine its nature and appearance, provided the environment is safe and comfortable for a living creature.

By default, the demiplane is inaccessible. As an action, you may create a temporary entrance using a door, window, trapdoor, or other openable barrier within your Sanctum. The entrance persists until you dismiss it, which requires the barrier to be closed.

improvements.name: Hearthway
improvements.description:
Your Sanctum contains a fireplace that allows you to travel to familiar locations.

Once per rest, choose up to 5 creatures and choose a location you have been to before which has a fireplace. For the next minute, if you or any of those creatures pass into the fireplace, you are teleported to the location you chose, emerging from the fireplace in that location in the same manner you entered your own. You are unharmed by any fire in either fireplace while the minute lasts.

The connection between the fireplaces is one-way and does not allow for travel back to your Sanctum.
